items.title: Chapter 3: a car you steer. W gas, S brake, A and D steer.
items.code:
note Chapter 3: a car you steer. W gas, S brake, A and D steer.
now xlb raylib
now InitWindow 1280&720&"My Drive School"
now SetTargetFPS 60
cam mgl Camera3D&
cam@up is Vector3&0.0&1.0&0.0
cam@fovy is 55.0
cam@projection is CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE
car mgl Car&
WindowShouldClose& weq nay
  dt is GetFrameTime&
  now read_keys now
  now move_car dt
  now follow_car now
  now BeginDrawing now
  now ClearBackground SKYBLUE
  now BeginMode3D cam
  now draw_world now
  now draw_car now
  now EndMode3D now
  sp is tfx&car@v*2.237&0
  now DrawText "Speed: @sp mph"&20&20&40&WHITE
  now EndDrawing now
now CloseWindow now

note Everything about our car.
Car dst now
  x dfd 0.0
  z dfd 20.0
  h dfd 0.0
  v dfd 0.0
  steer dfd 0.0
  gas dfd 0.0
  brake dfd 0.0
  turn dfd 0.0
  t dfd 0.0

note Read the keys. Each one sets a number from 0 to 1 (turn goes from -1 to 1).
read_keys dfn now
  car@gas is 0.0
  car@brake is 0.0
  car@turn is 0.0
  IsKeyDown&KEY_W ieq yes
    car@gas is 1.0
  IsKeyDown&KEY_S ieq yes
    car@brake is 1.0
  IsKeyDown&KEY_A ieq yes
    car@turn is -1.0
  IsKeyDown&KEY_D ieq yes
    car@turn is 1.0

note The simple physics: speed, steering and the turn of a car with front wheel steering.
move_car dfn now
  dt dpm dec
  v is car@v
  v add car@gas*5.0*dt
  v asb car@brake*10.0*dt
  v asb 0.8*dt
  v is nmx&0.0&v
  v is nmn&25.0&v
  car@v is v
  den is 1.0+v*v/150.0
  limit is 0.5/den
  target is car@turn*limit
  gap is target-car@steer
  car@steer add gap*5.0*dt
  t is ntn&car@steer
  car@h add v/2.7*t*dt
  sh is nsn&car@h
  ch is nco&car@h
  car@x add sh*v*dt
  car@z asb ch*v*dt

note The camera sits behind the car and looks ahead of it.
follow_car dfn now
  sh is nsn&car@h
  ch is nco&car@h
  cam@position is Vector3&car@x-sh*9.0&4.0&car@z+ch*9.0
  cam@target is Vector3&car@x+sh*6.0&1.0&car@z-ch*6.0

note The car: a red body, a glass top, four wheels and two lights. It turns with car at h.
draw_car dfn now
  now rlPushMatrix now
  now rlTranslatef car@x&0.0&car@z
  deg is car@h*-180.0/npi
  now rlRotatef deg&0.0&1.0&0.0
  now box 0.0&0.3&0.0&1.8&0.6&4.2&RED
  now box 0.0&0.85&0.3&1.6&0.55&2.0&SKYBLUE
  now box -0.95&0.0&-1.4&0.3&0.7&0.7&BLACK
  now box 0.95&0.0&-1.4&0.3&0.7&0.7&BLACK
  now box -0.95&0.0&1.4&0.3&0.7&0.7&BLACK
  now box 0.95&0.0&1.4&0.3&0.7&0.7&BLACK
  now box -0.6&0.5&-2.1&0.4&0.2&0.1&YELLOW
  now box 0.6&0.5&-2.1&0.4&0.2&0.1&YELLOW
  now rlPopMatrix now

note A box standing on the ground at x y z, w wide, h high, d deep.
box dfn now
  x dpm dec
  y dpm dec
  z dpm dec
  w dpm dec
  h dpm dec
  d dpm dec
  c dpm Color
  p is Vector3&x&y+h/2.0&z
  s is Vector3&w&h&d
  now DrawCubeV p&s&c

note Everything we see: grass, a road, white lines, and some trees.
draw_world dfn now
  now box 0.0&-0.1&0.0&300.0&0.1&300.0&DARKGREEN
  now box 0.0&0.0&0.0&8.0&0.05&300.0&DARKGRAY
  z is -140.0
  z flt 280.0
    now box 0.0&0.06&z&0.3&0.02&3.0&WHITE
    z add 8.0
  now box -4.0&0.06&0.0&0.2&0.02&300.0&YELLOW
  now box 4.0&0.06&0.0&0.2&0.02&300.0&YELLOW
  i flt 12
    tz is i*20.0-110.0
    now box -9.0&0.0&tz&0.6&3.0&0.6&BROWN
    now box -9.0&3.0&tz&3.0&3.0&3.0&GREEN
    now box 9.0&0.0&tz&0.6&3.0&0.6&BROWN
    now box 9.0&3.0&tz&3.0&3.0&3.0&GREEN

items.title: Dodge: a 2D game template for English++ and raylib. Left and
items.code:
note Dodge: a 2D game template for English++ and raylib. Left and right move, R restarts.
now xlb raylib
now InitWindow 800&600&"Dodge"
now SetTargetFPS 60
player mgl Player&
rocks mgl vec@Rock&
now restart now
WindowShouldClose& weq nay
  dt is GetFrameTime&
  player@alive ieq yes
    now update dt
  IsKeyPressed&KEY_R ieq yes
    now restart now
  now BeginDrawing now
  now ClearBackground DARKBLUE
  now draw_game now
  now EndDrawing now
now CloseWindow now

note Everything about the player.
Player dst now
  x dfd 400.0
  score dfd 0.0
  alive dfd yes

note One falling rock.
Rock dst now
  x dfd 0.0
  y dfd 0.0
  speed dfd 200.0

note Start again: the player in the middle, five rocks above the screen.
restart dfn now
  player@x is 400.0
  player@score is 0.0
  player@alive is yes
  rocks lwp now
  i flt 5
    r mak Rock
    r@x is nrz&20.0&780.0
    r@y is i*-150.0
    rocks add r

note Move the player, move the rocks, check for a hit.
update dfn now
  dt dpm dec
  IsKeyDown&KEY_LEFT ieq yes
    player@x asb 300.0*dt
  IsKeyDown&KEY_RIGHT ieq yes
    player@x add 300.0*dt
  player@x is nkb&player@x&20.0&780.0
  player@score add dt
  n is cct&rocks
  i flt n
    r mrf rocks@i
    r@y add r@speed*dt
    r@y igt 620.0
      r@y is -20.0
      r@x is nrz&20.0&780.0
      r@speed add 20.0
    dx is r@x-player@x
    dx is nab&dx
    dy is r@y-560.0
    dy is nab&dy
    dx ilt 30.0
      dy ilt 30.0
        player@alive is nay

note Draw the rocks, the player and the score.
draw_game dfn now
  n is cct&rocks
  i flt n
    r is rocks@i
    now DrawCircle r@x&r@y&15.0&GRAY
  now DrawRectangle player@x-20.0&550.0&40.0&20.0&YELLOW
  s is tfx&player@score&1
  now DrawText "Time: @s"&20&20&30&WHITE
  player@alive ieq nay
    now DrawText "Hit! Press R to play again."&180&280&30&RED

now xlb raylib

  IsKeyDown&KEY_UP ieq yes

  IsKeyDown&KEY_DOWN ieq yes

  now BeginDrawing now

  now BeginMode3D cam

  i flt 8
    a is i*0.785398
    px is nsn&a
    px is px*5.0
    pz is nco&a

    h is 1.0+i*0.4

    tint is ColorFromHSV&hue&0.7&0.9
    now DrawCube spot&1.0&h&1.0&tint

  now DrawSphere middle&1.0&GOLD
  now EndMode3D now
